## Changes

This release contains the known-checksum of the most recent uv releases and also disabled the uploading(saving) of the cache when in a merge queue since theses caches would almost never be used.

## 🚀 Enhancements

- Disable automatic cache saves for merge queues @eifinger (#1056)

## 🧰 Maintenance
